# Macrova

> Macrova is a free AI-powered nutrition and macro tracking app for Android. It logs food from a photo, sets personalized calorie and macro targets, and generates AI meal plans and workout plans. It also includes "AI Health Lab," which analyzes weekly eating patterns and surfaces personalized nutrition recommendations.

Macrova is built for people who want to track calories, protein, carbs, and fat without the friction of manual food search or spreadsheets. It is currently available on Android (iOS coming soon) and is localized in 7 languages: English, Hindi, Odia, French, Spanish, German, and Japanese.

## Key facts

- Platform: Android (Google Play). iOS: coming soon.
- Price: Free to download and start. Optional Premium unlocks AI meal + workout plans.
- Core capabilities: AI photo food logging, personalized calorie/macro targets, AI meal plans, AI workout plans, AI Health Lab weekly insights, barcode scanning, global food database.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Odia, French, Spanish, German, Japanese.

## Web dashboard

Existing Macrova users can sign in at https://app.macrova.in to view their nutrition dashboard on the web: daily calories and macros, weekly/monthly/yearly analytics, eating insights, meal history, and (with Premium) AI meal plans and workout plans. The web app is sign-in only — accounts are created in the mobile app.

## Primary pages

- [Home — features, how it works, screenshots](https://macrova.in/): Overview of Macrova's AI nutrition tracking, photo logging, meal/workout plans, and AI Health Lab.
- [Privacy Policy](https://macrova.in/privacy/): How Macrova handles user data.
- [Support](https://macrova.in/support/): Help and contact for Macrova users.
